title_en: What a Caller to God Must Have
body_ar:
الدعوة إلى الله من أعظم القربات، وأعظم الواجبات، وبها يهدي الله أقواماً ضلوا سواء السبيل. وللدعوة وسائل لابد من توافرها لنجاحها، كما لابد من وجود صفات مهمة في الداعي إلى الله؛ ليكون ناجحاً وموفقاً في عمله.
فضل الدعوة والدعاة:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فموضوعنا هذا بعنوان: (مقومات الداعية) وسنتكلم فيه إن شاء الله على العناصر التالية: فضل الدعوة والدعاة. فائدة الدعوة. أهداف الدعوة. وسائل الدعوة. صفات الداعية الناجح. إن الله سبحانه وتعالى وصف نفسه بالدعوة فقال: وَاللَّهُ يَدْعُوا إِلَى دَارِ السَّلامِ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ [يونس:25] ، ووصف رسوله الكريم صلى الله عليه وسلم بالدعوة فقال: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُنِيرًا [الأحزاب:46]..
body_en:
*[Site synopsis]* Calling people to God is among the greatest of the acts that bring one near to Him, and among the greatest of obligatory duties (wājibāt); through it God guides peoples who had strayed from the even path. The call has means that must be present if it is to succeed, just as there must be certain important qualities in the one who calls people to God, if he is to be successful and to be granted success in his work.

## The merit of the call and of those who make it

In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Mercy-Giving. Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds. I ask God's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his Companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the Day of Judgement. To proceed: the title of our subject here is "What a Caller to God Must Have", and in it, God willing, we shall speak on the following elements:

The merit of the call and of those who make it.
The benefit of the call.
The aims of the call.
The means of the call.
The qualities of the successful caller.

God, glorified and exalted is He, described Himself as calling, and said: {And God calls to the abode of peace, and He guides whom He wills to a straight path} (Sūrat Yūnus 10:25). And He described His noble Messenger, God bless him and grant him peace, as calling, and said: {and as one calling to God by His leave, and as an illuminating lamp} (Sūrat al-Aḥzāb 33:46) ..

It breaks off after a bare list of the five elements the lesson will cover and two proof-texts, with not one of the five elements addressed — including the qualities of the caller, which is the subject of the title. The complete text sits behind /medias/doc/c-c-30.doc. The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends and completes nothing. Must not be rendered as a whole lesson.

flags.note: The only ruling term in the record, and it is the site's word, not the Sheikh's — the transcribed portion does not classify the call at all. 'واجب' is rendered 'obligatory' per the fixed mapping. Note that the synopsis states a ruling the lesson as served never reaches, so the ruling must not be presented as the Sheikh's. He may or may not hold that calling people to God is individually obligatory rather than communally obligatory; the served text does not say, and the English does not decide it.

flags.note: 'مقومات' are the things that constitute something and without which it does not stand — not merely desirable attributes. The lesson's own outline distinguishes 'مقومات' (the title) from 'صفات الداعية الناجح' (the fifth element), so the two must not be collapsed into 'qualities' in both places.

translator_notes: One of a run of six records, IDs 701-706, in the written-da'wah section, all uploaded on 9 May 2011 within about twenty minutes of one another, all built to the same template and all excerpts. Each carries a site-written synopsis, then a section heading, then the opening formula and the first lines of a lesson, and then breaks off on an ellipsis; the full text sits behind a .doc download in the /medias/doc/c-c-* series. The uniform timestamps are a bulk upload and say nothing about when the lesson was delivered.

The record contains two distinct voices and the English keeps them apart. The opening paragraph is a synopsis written by the site, about the lesson and in the third person; everything from the section heading onward is the Sheikh's own words as transcribed. Nothing in the synopsis may be quoted as his.

The source's final line, 'تحميل المادة' ('download the material'), is the label of a download link in the page furniture, not part of the text. It is recorded as source_download_link and omitted from body_ar and body_en.
Qur'anic renderings here are interpretive and are not a substitute for the Arabic.
The last record of this run. The transcribed portion consists of the opening formula, a table of contents and two verses; none of the five announced elements is addressed.
The source ends with two dots rather than the three used elsewhere in the run; reproduced as served.
